welcome.title: Welcome to {name}
welcome.subtitle: To get started, you need the profile file your administrator sent you.
open.confirmTitle: Switch to the profile of {username} on {host}?
open.confirmHelp: You are now using the one for {username} on {host}. Your key stays the same; if the new server doesn't know it, you'll have to send it to its administrator.
welcome.admin: Do you manage the server? Start by creating your profile
topbar.label: Settings and administration
settings.title: Settings
settings.help: Your preferences are saved on this computer and apply right away.
settings.appearance.help: The Theme changes the colors of the app and the Terminal.
settings.transparency.help: The window frame lets what's behind it show through. Turn it off if it feels slow or you prefer solid colors.
settings.transparency.unavailable: High contrast is always opaque, so the contrast stays high.
settings.shortcuts.help: Press “Change” and then the keys of the new Shortcut. Escape cancels.
settings.shortcuts.conflict: {combo} is already used by “{action}”. Press another combination, or change the one for “{action}” first.
settings.shortcuts.conflictTerminal: {combo} is already used by the Terminal tabs. Press another combination.
settings.language.help: The language of the app. With System, your computer's language if it is Spanish or English, and English otherwise.
create.title: Create profile
create.help: Fill in the details of the person who will use the app. We work out the server fingerprint when connecting; you don't have to copy it.
create.helpOwn: Start with your own profile: the server, your Linux user and Advanced mode. Then you can create everyone else's from the app.
create.usernameHelp: Their Linux user; each person has their own.
create.simpleHelp: Files only, in their home folder and the shared folder.
create.advancedHelp: Adds the Terminal and emptying the Trash.
create.sharedFolderHelp: Full path on the server, for example /srv/shared.
create.adminHelp: Will be able to create profiles from the app.
create.saveDialog: Choose where to save the profile
create.fingerprintHelp: The profile already includes the server fingerprint, which the app uses to check it is connecting to the real one. You don't have to do anything with it.
create.nextStep: Send the file to {username}. Once they import it, they'll send you their public key: paste it below, in “Authorize key”, and add the resulting line on the server.
create.nextStepOwn: Now import it: the app will give you your public key to authorize on the server.
authorize.title: Authorize key
authorize.help: The server enforces the mode, not the app: authorize each key with the line for its mode and nobody can get around it by editing their profile.
authorize.ownerHelp: Goes at the end of the line, so you can recognize it when you need to remove it. Useful if several keys share a user.
authorize.lineHelp: On the server, add this line to the file /etc/ssh/authorized_keys/ followed by their user (the server guide explains why there and not in their folder):
authorize.invalid: That doesn't look like a public key. Paste the whole line they sent you, which starts with “ssh-ed25519”.
create.invalid.host: Write the address without spaces or “/”, for example vps.example.com.
create.invalid.port: Write a number between 1 and 65535. It is usually 22.
create.invalid.username: Use lowercase letters, numbers, “_” or “-”, starting with a letter or “_”.
create.invalid.sharedFolder: Write the full path, starting with “/”, or leave it empty.
unauthorized.title: One step left: getting access
ready.subtitle: You'll connect as {username} to {host}.
ready.keyHelp: Send this key to the administrator so they can give you access to the server. It is safe to share.
ready.copyFailed: Couldn't copy it. Select the text and copy it by hand.
connect.title: Connecting…
connect.wait: Just a moment, we're getting into the server.
problem.title: We couldn't connect
explorer.deleted: “{name}” has been moved to the Trash.
editor.notText: “{name}” isn't a text file, so it can't be opened in the Editor.
editor.largeHelp: Files over 5 MB may take a while to open and make the Editor slow.
editor.noFile: This window no longer has a file. Close it and open the file again from the Explorer.
editor.offlineHelp: The connection to the server was lost. Your text is still here: reconnect from the main window and save again.
editor.reconnected: Connection restored. You can save now.
editor.closeHelp: Your unsaved changes will be lost.
editor.conflictHelp: Someone modified it after you opened it. If you overwrite it, their changes will be lost. If you save a copy, both are kept.
editor.quitHelp: If you close the app, the Editor closes too and your unsaved changes will be lost.
editor.switchHelp: Switching profiles closes the Editor windows and your unsaved changes will be lost.
trash.title: Trash
trash.help: Whatever you delete stays here. Right-click a file or folder to put it back where it was.
trash.restoredAs: “{original}” is back in {dir} as “{name}”, because something with that name was already there.
trash.confirmHelp: You can get it back from the Trash.
trash.helpAdvanced: Whatever you delete stays here. Right-click a file or folder to put it back where it was or delete it forever.
trash.emptyConfirmHelp: Everything in it will be deleted forever. This can't be undone.
trash.deleteConfirmHelp: It can't be recovered. This can't be undone.
terminal.title: Terminal
terminal.label: Server Terminal {number}
update.installing: Updating to version {version}… The app will restart by itself.
update.confirmHelp: Some transfers haven't finished. If you update now, they'll be cut off and you'll have to start them again once the app restarts.
transfers.title: Transfers
transfers.uploadedAs: Uploaded to {path} as “{name}”, because something with that name was already there
transfers.lost: The connection to the server was lost. It will pick up where it left off as soon as you reconnect.
transfers.cancelled: Cancelled. Nothing was left half done.
transfers.uploadDialog: Choose the files you want to upload
error.profile.unreadable: Couldn't open that file. Check that it exists and try again.
error.profile.malformed: That file doesn't look like a valid profile. Ask the administrator to send you a new one.
error.profile.unsupported_version: That profile is from a newer version. Update the app or ask the administrator for a new one.
error.profile.invalid_field: The profile has incorrect data. Ask the administrator to send you a new one.
error.secrets.unavailable: Can't access your computer's secure storage, where your key is kept. Check that the system keyring is running.
error.update.failed: Couldn't update. Download the new version and install it by hand.
error.update.unavailable: That update is no longer available. Reopen the app to look for another one.
error.storage.failed: Couldn't save the information on your computer. Try again.
error.connection.no_profile: You haven't imported a profile yet.
error.connection.fingerprint_mismatch: We couldn't verify that the server is the real one, so we didn't connect or send anything. Let the administrator know.
error.connection.unauthorized: The server doesn't recognize your key yet. Send it to the administrator and, when they tell you that you have access, press “Retry”.
error.connection.unreachable: We couldn't reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.connection.not_connected: You aren't connected to the server. Press “Retry”.
error.connection.lost: The connection to the server was lost. Press “Retry”.
error.files.permission_denied: The server doesn't give you permission to do this. If you need it, ask the administrator.
error.files.not_found: That folder or file doesn't exist. Someone may have moved or deleted it.
error.files.already_exists: There is already a file or folder with that name here. Choose another one.
error.files.invalid_name: Write a name that isn't empty and doesn't contain “/”. “.” and “..” aren't allowed either.
error.files.create_folder_failed: Couldn't create the folder. Try again.
error.files.rename_failed: Couldn't change the name. Try again.
error.files.trash_failed: Couldn't move it to the Trash, so nothing was deleted. Try again and, if it keeps failing, let the administrator know.
error.files.trash_protected: That can't be deleted because it is the Trash or contains it.
error.files.outside_allowed: That folder is outside your home folder and the shared folder, so it can't be used from here.
error.files.delete_failed: Couldn't delete everything; what's left is still in the Trash. Try again and, if it keeps failing, let the administrator know.
error.mode.advanced_only: This is only available in Advanced mode. If you need it, ask the administrator for an advanced profile.
error.terminal.failed: The server doesn't allow the Terminal for your user. If you need it, ask the administrator.
error.files.restore_failed: Couldn't restore it; it is still in the Trash. Try again.
error.editor.not_text: This file isn't UTF-8, so the Editor can't open it without damaging it. Download it to open it on your computer.
error.editor.read_failed: Couldn't read the file. Check that it isn't a folder and try again.
error.editor.write_failed: Couldn't save the file. The server may be out of space. Your text is still here: try again.
error.editor.conflict: This file has changed on the server since you opened it. Your text is still here.
error.transfer.local_unreadable: Couldn't read that file or folder on your computer. Check that it is still there and that you can open it.
error.transfer.local_write_failed: Couldn't save to that folder on your computer. Choose another one or check that there is free space.
error.transfer.failed: The transfer couldn't finish. The server may be out of space. Try again.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. Try again.
